scope: Retrospective small-panel exploration. Existing G330 outcomes were inspected. Whole-study tests are external protocol shifts, not prospective trials or isolated species causal effects.
cohort_rule: Common complete global mask intersection from every panel; no effect-size selection; only complete drug contrasts across human and all named sources.

methods.scaled: One nonnegative no-intercept slope per source, fitted to historical task/gene loss.
methods.affine_gene_mean: Training-human gene mean + one nonnegative source slope times deviation from its training-source gene mean.
methods.fusion: All nonempty source subsets; equal and simplex shrinkage. Objective=historicalOOF MSE / historical human RMS² + ||w-uniform||². Fixed multiplier1.
methods.selection: Raw best fixed source from historical raw-copy error; calibrated source choice from historical leave-one-task-out predictions. No query treated human outcome.
methods.control_selection: Pearson of already available source and target untreated controls; fixed original source ordering resolves ties. It uses all source control information and has a different acquisition budget from history-only source choice.
methods.zero_slope_fallback: Zero historical source innovation variance yields beta0. Affine calibration with one reference task reduces to its human mean.

scoring: Per-drug full-axis MSE, Pearson, response RMS; no gene/sample-count significance claims.
budget: Original available arm profiles per acquired source; added sources generally increase measurement budget. This study-transfer analysis does not equalize acquisition costs.

sensitivity.unit: Original treated/control arm records; shared original control sets reuse a draw; fitted historical coefficients stay fixed.
sensitivity.limitation: Rat CPZ may have one record; resampling cannot estimate its unobserved replicate variability. Donor identities unresolved.
